title: picker no max menu height
rule: No maximum menu height — grow to show as many options as the available space allows. Field value truncates; menu (and label) wrap.
pass_when: Menu grows with available space (no artificial max); field value may truncate; menu and label wrap.
fail_when: A capped menu that hides available-space options, or menu that truncates like the field.
overview: Picker menus grow with available space; no artificial maximum height.
apply_when: Long picker menus where options should fill available viewport space.
not_when: Field-value truncation in the closed button, which may still ellipsize.
agent_hint: Let the menu grow with space; wrap menu and label, do not invent a max height.
description: Spectrum picker menus have no maximum height: they grow to show as many options as available space allows. The closed field value may truncate, while menu items and labels wrap. Capping the menu so available-space options stay hidden, or truncating menu copy like the field button, fails the pattern. Use this when reviewing long option lists; do not confuse field-value ellipsis with a menu height cap.
do_not_claim: Item wrapping discouraged (next row) as a max-height rule.
